source_policy: AGENTS.md; COTS FIRST; source-controlled manufacturer references and deliberate gates

envelope.shutdown_total_battery_target_ua: <100 for TripTracer vehicle system; module budget not yet allocated

requirements.auxiliary_protected_input_voltage: follows_fused_input_after_overvoltage_and_reverse_protection; unregulated, can collapse during cutoff; NOT 5V or fixed 15V
requirements.auxiliary_protected_output_short_circuit: Only common upstream vehicle source fuse and shared LM74930 OCP/SCP; no separate auxiliary branch fuse, not selectively isolated. Design all copper/cables and connectors for maximum clearing I2t/time at vehicle source short circuit and LM74930 FET stuck ON.
requirements.auxiliary_protected_max_output_current_s: 1A provisional extra load design target, not a guaranteed limit. All downstream paths protected only by shared upstream vehicle main fuse and LM74930 under normal operation.

main_vehicle_fuse.location: vehicle harness close to source and before ALL TripTracer module power wires
main_vehicle_fuse.status: DESIGN_EXAMPLE_NOT_SELECTED: At 9V 10W/80% + 1A AUX draws 2.39A; MINI 58V 3A derates to 2A typical at 80C.
selection_requirements: available worst-case fault current and I2t
9V full load including aux and inrush
cable/connector/copper withstand when LM74930 FET shorted

project_boundaries.standalone_default_on: Draft R319=0R jumper in series with R318=100k from VS_CLAMP to EN; standalone only. D305 blocks backfeed into RUN.
project_boundaries.logic_enable_mode: Draft 3.3/5V active-high RUN_CMD -> R317=4.7k -> D305 reverse blocker -> LM74930 EN with 100k pull-down R316. Raw ACC never directly at RUN. Behavior with VIN=0 and powered RUN needs measurement.
project_boundaries.power_return: Common GND; layout must protect high-current ground and switching return
project_boundaries.output_connector_plan: J301 VIN_FUSED/RUN_CMD/GND and J302 VIN_PROTECTED_UNFUSED/5V_OUT/GND. No F302, no auxiliary inline/PCB fuse required. Conductors subject to upstream fuse time-current and I2t.
project_boundaries.raw_auxiliary_branch: LM74930 switched FET path -> shared R301 5mOhm sense shunt -> VIN_PROTECTED_UNFUSED shared with U101 VIN and J302.1, deliberately without separate branch fuse.
project_boundaries.raw_auxiliary_branch_status: WIRED_UNFUSED_ON_STANDALONE_SCHEMATIC; no mainboard branch fuse expected; native KiCad ERC recheck open
project_boundaries.main_vehicle_fuse_location: Vehicle source close to battery/feed, before TripTracer power input cable

proposed_external_signals.name: VIN_FUSED
proposed_external_signals.role: fused positive source; not a bare battery cable

proposed_external_signals.name: 5V_OUT
proposed_external_signals.role: regulated rail, overload behavior to be tested

proposed_external_signals.name: VIN_PROTECTED_UNFUSED
proposed_external_signals.role: Physically present at J302.1. Behind LM74930 electronic shared breaker but deliberately without additional fuse. Requires entire vehicle source feed fused externally.
proposed_external_signals.protection: Main source fuse covers all wiring, connector and PCB branches when correctly sized to time-current/I2t; shared electronic OCP/SCP may switch off both outputs. No separately protected branch and no independent continuity guarantee.

proposed_external_signals.name: RUN_CMD
proposed_external_signals.role: enable request via separate input conditioner; no BAT or VS at logic pin; floating OFF in controlled mode

protection_comparison.design_reason: Programmable combined-load breaker plus short-circuit protection via shared shunt upstream of VIN_PROTECTED branch; LM74800 lacks OCP
open_gates: Shunt and separate auxiliary current fault protection

stop_gates: protection: 9V VS-chargepump dynamic startup and safe EN-off hot leakage
protection: 200V Q921 SOA, Q922 voltage, VS zener and divider pulse ratings
protection: short from fused VIN to GND BEFORE buck, FET shorted, cable fuse coordination
control: source-independent 3.3/5V RUN pin interface and power-off leakage/backfeed
manufacturing: FCH0650-150M pad drawing, exact footprints, paste and 3D
PCB: actual independent native KiCad 10 ERC, PCB parity, routed DRC and review
hardware: 9/12/24/30V 2A thermal, output ripple/EMI, short/fail-off/surge laboratory tests
economics: complete competing 1,10,100pc BOM ex shipping and assembly with live pricing
Aux VIN_PROTECTED_UNFUSED: total input/thermal budget must cover max 5V/2A and external raw-side load simultaneously; no unbounded raw output claim
Display: Riverdi constant-current 100mA LED driver from V5_SYS and USB source-current negotiation/derating; no forced 15V constant voltage source
VIN_PROTECTED_UNFUSED: all traces, cable and connectors are protected by single shared source fuse, including if FETs fail shorted, and without branch-selective separation
Main fuse 3A only initial example, 9V max loads 2.39A and 3A 58V MINI at 80C typ sustained 2A; examine 4/5A with full fault current/I2t and 12/24V rating

cost_review.reason: Never fabricate mixed tax or stale retailer prices
additional_required_cost_roles: One user-supplied external replaceable common vehicle source fuse F_MAIN (not an onboard TripPower/TripTracer component)
All downstream copper and wiring for worst-case fuse clearing I2t

pass_status.vin_protected_physical_connection: J302.1 directly on VIN_PROTECTED_UNFUSED same common shunt net as buck; F302 removed
pass_status.vin_protected_current_rating: 1A design goal, 3A source fuse unvalidated at 80C; compare 4A or 5A with wire/copper I2t

display_backlight_design.input_rail: TripTracer V5_SYS after TPS2116 source selector when USB operation of backlight is desired; power budget and USB allowed current mandatory
display_backlight_design.alternative_use_VIN_PROTECTED: NOT_SELECTED; would need 9-30V-capable buck-boost constant-current driver, with own protective load branch
